newsitem.title: UK: Land Securities helped by short positions.
newsitem.headline: Land Securities helped by short positions.

text.p: Shares in Land Securities Plc were squeezed higher on Tuesday, benefiting from renewed buying interest coupled with a shortage of stock as the domestic interest rate outlook continued to brighten.
The shares bounced to a twelve month high of 895p then eased to be up 12-1/2p at 883-1/2p by 0834 GMT. Volume was 1.9 million shares.
"We're seeing some big buyers of the properties around today," said one senior dealer.
"There's buyers around for the whole sector because the roaring gilt market makes property shares look attractive," another trader said.
Shares in British Land climbed 5p to 605p.
"Property stocks seem to be the ones people are going for," said a third dealer.
"One or two people in the market have been caught with bad books and there is talk that the sector is just unbuyable. Underneath it is all this talk of low inflation."
In the last two weeks shares in Land Securities have risen over 11 percent.
